L6: #### Feemster’s Corn Maze
L7: ### Just north of I-44 and 65 Hwy, off Bluegrass Road.
L8: 
L9: You can drive north on Glenstone via H Highway, or drive north on 65 Highway, just past I-44 intersection. Here’s a map that might help.
L10: 
L11: If you’re driving down Highway 65, go north on 65 past I-44, and turn left on Bluegrass Rd. The corn maze will be about 1 1/2 miles on your right.
L12: If you’re driving north on Glenstone Ave, go north past Kearney St., and I-44 until you pass the intersection of Valley Water Mill. Go through the intersection and past Dollar General, for about 1/2 mile and turn right on Farm Rd. 94. The corn maze will be on your left past the farm about a mile down the road.
